Kaeryn bundles the Lucide icon name map from [Footagesus/Icons](https://github.com/Footagesus/Icons),
file `lucide/dist/Icons.lua`, pinned to commit `46d30c19ba7bc601d6ec794a48dc3a89568b1eec`.

The upstream MIT license is included in `Footagesus-Icons-LICENSE.txt`. The bundled map contains
icon names and Roblox asset IDs; Kaeryn resolves those names locally and does not fetch or execute
the upstream source at runtime.
